Jon Rahm expresses hopes of re-joining PGA Tour following LIV Golf exit
Tuesday 3 November 2026 09:35, UK
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Jon Rahm reveals the changes to LIV 2.0 that made him quit the tour, whilst also admitting that he'd take the same deal as Brooks Koepka to re-join the PGA Tour if the offer was still on the table.
